output.summary: The zero-deviation record is most plausibly an artifact of the February 2026 supervisor bonus penalty. Reporting stopped on all lines, while customer complaints (11 to 31 ppm), independent QC rejections (0.8% to 1.3%) and survey fear of speaking up all worsened. Line 3's 118% plan attainment is explained by unrecorded borrowed technicians. Output per technician-hour is unchanged, so its practices are not transferable. Training and the tubing switch do not fit the timing or the line pattern. Rework on Line 3 is alleged but unverified, and the Plant Manager's role is unknown. Suspend the penalty, start an independent investigation, and do not roll out Line 3, discipline anyone yet, or unmask the reporter.
